name: retry-then-succeed
notes: sequence with no advanceOn, so the trigger is `self`: the cursor moves each time this rule answers. The first attempt to place an order fails with a 503, the second succeeds — the shape you need to exercise retry logic, which a fixed response cannot produce. A third attempt gets Lyrebird's own 500 saying the sequence is exhausted, because onExhausted defaults to `error`: repeating the last step would let an unplanned extra request pass for a successful one. Set it to repeatLast or passThrough if more requests are expected.
